His face is turned about 80 degrees toward picture-right, chin lowered about 30 degrees, looking down at the beach, mouth closed, eyes hidden by the turn. He wears a faded maroon cotton baseball cap backwards, brim toward picture-left, his dark curly hair showing below it, his full dark beard, his silver neck chain with a small pendant, his janeu, a thin white thread from his left shoulder at picture-right across his chest to his right hip at picture-left, and faded black jeans worn low; no glasses. Behind him is the Gokarna beach trek: a steep red laterite headland with dry golden grass and green scrub at picture-left, pale feathery grass plumes at the bottom-left, and at picture-right the deep-blue Arabian Sea, dark rocks in white surf and a curving golden beach lined with coconut palms. He is alone. Hard midday sun from high in front and slightly picture-left, cloudless deep-blue sky. Camera at his eye height two metres away, phone 1x, horizon level, bottom edge cutting his thighs, fine grain. Vertical 3:4 frame.
